what: Check 79 (session 277, 2026-11-16), after the presentation. The Studio offered a correction of this work's own coding (studio@1cdfe75, works/2026-11-15-other-hands/check/state-second-reading.json): four of the 34 acts the check coded as concluded are only begun by this work's own rule, and two acts coded as landing on a developer or deployer went in that party's favour. The conductor fetched the snapshot a fifth time (same hash), read the response reports of the six incidents whole, without length cut, and then read the act of every one of the 69 public acts for its direction. Each entry gives the report read, a short quotation from it, and the code as it now stands. No report text beyond the quotation is copied. One reader, a machine reader.
rule_state: check77/CODEBOOK.md, Part B: opened = inquiry, investigation, charge, suit taken up, no outcome in the text; concluded = an order, fine, ban, ruling, sentence, law passed, settlement approved. Read as the Studio read it and as this work already coded incidents 93, 1499 and 1506: a proposed order, a plea before the sentence and an instruction whose outcome is not in the text are opened.
rule_direction: against = the act charges, orders, fines, bans, rules against or investigates the party it lands on; for = the body acted in that party's favour (dismissed the suit against it, moved to have it dismissed, declined to sanction).
